M-DISCOVERY.Purpose: Traverse ancestors directly from concrete files and perform one bounded full-graph scan from a fixed region.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Ancestor-only traversal: anchor -> declaration -> resolved literal parents -> repeat.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Full downward scan of the directory tree rooted at `graphBoundary(anchor)`.
Scope.SCP-IN-003: Disposable declaration cache as acceleration for repeated full scans.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Full scan of directories around external ancestors.
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: Authoritative manifest, registry, watcher, daemon, persistent index.

Requirements.REQ-001: `ancestors` never calls `ProjectIndex.scan`; `graph` scans exactly one inferred/explicit boundary tree fixed before the scan begins.
Requirements.REQ-002: External ancestors (resolved parents outside the region) are inspected directly and recursively for their own `parents`; their surrounding directories are never full-scanned.
Requirements.REQ-003: The full scan skips `.git`, generated dependency/build/cache directories, and FLI derived cache paths.
Requirements.REQ-004: A scanned file is not automatically a graph node; participation is a valid declaration holder or a resolved parent target.
Requirements.REQ-005: A cached declaration source is reused only while its filesystem fingerprint is unchanged and the cached read succeeded; new/changed/previously unreadable files are read fresh.
Requirements.REQ-006: Traversal, metadata, or read failure produces an explicit diagnostic; failure cannot prove absence.
Requirements.REQ-007: Cache load/corruption/persist/lock failure cannot change graph truth; Core derived-state concurrency failure fails open.
Requirements.REQ-008: Filesystem traversal is canonical; no ripgrep dependency is part of Core correctness.

Inputs.IN-001: Ancestor anchor: existing regular file path.
Inputs.IN-002: Graph anchor: existing file or directory path.
